title: Garmin Run Indonesia Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Garmin Run Indonesia Review: The 2025 Edition | ICE BSD
meta_description: Garmin Run Indonesia review: more than 7,000 runners at ICE BSD in September 2025, with disability access, insurance and a waste programme built in.
dek: Garmin's Indonesian leg of its Asia race series is run around the ICE BSD exhibition centre in Tangerang. Here is what the September 2025 edition was like, the one before the 20 September 2026 race.
verdict: Garmin Run Indonesia is a brand race, and a well-resourced one. Its third edition, on 14 September 2025, put more than 7,000 runners on a course around ICE BSD across the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and a kids' dash [1]. What set it apart was not the course but what surrounded it: sign-language interpreters and routes adapted for disabled runners, a health partner offering pre-race screening, race insurance from collection to race day, and a waste-management partner [1]. For 2026 the organisers planned for 8,000 [2]. If you want a well-organised half marathon near Jakarta with good support, this is a safe pick.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: The 2025 race was held on Sunday 14 September from the Hall 10 car park at ICE BSD, in Tangerang, and was the event's third edition [1]. More than 7,000 people took part, from children to professional athletes, across the 5 km, 10 km, half marathon and a kids' dash [1]. It is the Indonesian stop of the Garmin Run Asia Series [1].
Rikki Simbolon won the men's half marathon in about 1 hour 14 minutes and Marhaendrassiwi D Palupi the women's in about 1 hour 32 minutes [1].

sections.heading: Access, Safety and Waste
paragraphs: The 2025 race made room for disabled runners: deaf runners, wheelchair users and other disability communities took part, and the organisers provided sign-language interpreters, a large visual countdown and disability-friendly lanes [1]. A wheelchair basketball team from Jakarta ran the 5 km alongside everyone else [1].

Allianz provided insurance from race pack collection through race day, and Halodoc provided a pre-race health screening questionnaire and medical services [1]. Part of the entry fee went to mangrove planting, and the waste partner Limbah.id reported collecting 530.82 kg of rubbish across the pre-race events, 67% of it recycled [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter?
paragraphs: If you want a half marathon near Jakarta with good support and a big field, yes. The event is corporate, but that shows in the planning: insurance, health screening and disability access are all in place.
The published reporting says little about the course itself beyond its start at ICE BSD, so if the route matters to you, check the course map before entering.

This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race. No report on how the 20 September 2026 race went had been published when it was written.

faqs.question: How many people ran Garmin Run Indonesia in 2025?
faqs.answer: More than 7,000 participants, from children to professional athletes, took part on Sunday 14 September 2025 at ICE BSD in Tangerang, across the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and kids' dash. For the 20 September 2026 edition the organisers planned for 8,000.

faqs.question: Is Garmin Run Indonesia accessible for disabled runners?
faqs.answer: In 2025 it was deliberately so. Deaf runners, wheelchair users and other disability communities took part, and the organisers provided sign-language interpreters, a large visual countdown and disability-friendly lanes, with a Jakarta wheelchair basketball team running the 5 km.

faqs.question: Where is Garmin Run Indonesia held?
faqs.answer: Around the Indonesia Convention Exhibition (ICE) in BSD City, Tangerang, just outside Jakarta. In 2025 the race gathered in the Hall 10 car park at ICE BSD.

editorial_notes: Rewritten 2026-09-28 about the previous edition (14 September 2025). Replaces a pre-race preview. The 2026 figure of 8,000 is the organisers' pre-race target, not a result. No rating: nothing here is participant evidence.
